The WorkThe Work
Scope agreed together

What is a brand kit?

Everything your brand needs to look like itself, everywhere.

A brand kit holds your logo in every format and colour, your colours with their exact codes, your typefaces, and a guide that shows how to use them.

Your website, social posts, signs, print and merchandise all draw from the same kit. So your brand looks the same wherever people meet it, and anyone who works on it gets it right the first time.

What’s inside

  • Logo suite

    Every version of your logo, in colour, black and white, as SVG, PDF and PNG files.

  • Colour palette

    Your colours with exact HEX, RGB, CMYK and Pantone values, for screen and print.

  • Scope agreed together

    The typefaces that sound like your brand, and how to size them.

  • Brand guidelines

    A brand book that shows how to use it all, and what to avoid.

  • Applications

    Your brand on social posts, stationery, signs and merchandise.

  • Motion

    A logo animation for videos, reels and your website.
